q: Given: True track 175o Drift 10oR Compass heading 195o Deviation -3o Calculate the variation?
exp: True heading = true track - right drift = 175 - 10 = 165 T. Magnetic heading = compass + deviation = 195 + (-3) = 192 M. Variation = 192 - 165 = 27 deg; magnetic is greater than true, so variation is west: 27W.
